people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD by following the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, after the abominations of the nations whom Jehovah cast out before the children of Israel.
